layoutNotes: Single persistent hub scene serving as the social lobby, upgrade area, market, workshop, command overlook, training court, and mission deployment space.

Ground circulation forms a loop around a central social plaza. Major destinations branch to east market lane, southeast workshop, west training garden, and north command overlook with vertical access.
The map is bounded as a contained playable hub slice while preserving skyline vistas, overgrown ruins, rooftop utilities, and rebel settlement storytelling.
userData.artStyle: Outdoor overgrown resistance safe haven; Halo CE / Half-Life 2 inspired industrial ruins with dense rebel dressing.
